node.title: XR first residual rank-two shell is quadratic-involutional
node.statement: In an official odd-characteristic uniform high-core split pencil at affine kernel rank a, every rank-two trade on the first post-face-quotient shell |X|=a+3 is quadratic-involutional. Its pairwise-disjoint row-zero sets have sizes one or two, with at most one singleton, and 4<=t<=floor((a+4)/2). The degree-at-most-two polynomial pencil has degree exactly two, so all two-point zero fibers are cycles of one base-field Mobius involution. The row coefficients also satisfy the two exact slope-weighted dual-RS_2 checks. This reduces the first residual shell to ownership and counting of quadratic-pullback charts; it does not pay them or classify higher shells and higher trade rank.
